item.title: New Seahawks offensive coordinator Brian Fleury eager for opportunity
item.description: Brian Fleury has never called plays on offense at any level. He will take over those responsibilities held by former Seattle Seahawks offensive coordinator Klint Kubiak, who left to be the Las Vegas Raiders head coach.

item.title: 4A State Gymnastics: Union’s Carly Christ closes career with fourth podium finish in events final
item.description: In her final high school gymnastics competition, Union’s Carly Christ left the balance beam, well, beaming.

item.title: Vancouver city leaders bury time capsule that won’t be opened until 2125
item.description: Vancouver’s Downtown Association on Friday buried a sealed time capsule full of various artifacts at Main and West 13th streets to preserve a snapshot of the city. The stainless steel box will remain buried until 2125.

item.title: 300-acre site dubbed ‘Quail Haven’ now protected from development
item.description: SPOKANE — Roughly 300 acres that is a stone’s throw from the Washington-Idaho border will remain a vibrant natural area, according to a Wednesday announcement from the Inland Northwest Land Conservancy.

item.title: Man accused of crashing into Spokane police car
item.description: SPOKANE — A reported drive-by shooting Wednesday turned into a police chase, with the suspect crashing into a Spokane police car before officers arrested him, police said.

item.title: Custodian who worked at Image Elementary accused of possessing child sex abuse materials
item.description: A custodian who worked at Image Elementary School is accused of possessing child sex abuse materials. School officials say investigators don’t believe the alleged crimes are related to any activities at the school.

item.title: Mariners baseball returns to record spring training crowd for opening win
item.description: Michael Arroyo's blasts off his bat set the tone for the Seattle Mariners' 7-4 victory over the San Diego Padres, their Peoria neighbors, on a pleasant afternoon for the first game of spring training.

item.title: Blazers run out of their own building by Nuggets, 157-103
item.description: Nikola Jokic had 32 points, nine rebounds and seven assists in 29 1/2 minutes and the Denver Nuggets routed Portland 157-103 on Friday night for the most points on the road in franchise history and the most in an NBA game this season.
